description:
Factual diagnostic projection emitted by `archlens explain`. This is a DERIVED, explicitly non-authoritative output (plan section 3.3). It carries an independent format version and must never be read back as measurement evidence.

1.1 exists because 1.0 described five properties while the command emitted twelve, under `additionalProperties: false` — so every real invocation violated the schema that claimed to describe it. Nothing validated the output, so the drift was invisible. 1.0 is retained unchanged as historical material and is not the current contract.

evaluable_dimensions.description: Which optional dimensions were present, so an absent dimension is reported as not evaluable rather than as a negative finding.

grouping_semantics.description: Must state that groups are ATTENTION grouping, not severity and not research impact (plan section 12.2).

relative_path.description: Null is correct for acquisition, cleanup, traversal, Git-mode-map, and run-integrity evidence (plan section 10.2). Never a guessed path.

lifecycle.description: Structural readability of the run, from `classify_lifecycle`. This is NOT a success verdict: a run whose artifacts decode but whose integrity failed is `finalized_valid` with a failed `run_integrity_status`. Use `run_integrity_status` for success.

repository_filter.description: The `--repository` filter in effect, or null.

repository_filter_unmatched.description: True when a filter was supplied and matched no repository. Reported rather than silently returning an empty explanation.

run_evidence.description: Run-scoped diagnostic evidence. Half of the shared diagnostic model; previously discarded here, which let `explain` report a lifecycle of `finalized_invalid` while showing nothing about why.

run_integrity_status.description: The run's own terminal integrity verdict, copied from run_status.json. Null when no terminal status was ever published. This, not `lifecycle`, decides whether the run succeeded.

title: ArchLens explain output 1.1
